thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: auto-alert - sudden surge in 5xx rates from west-us edge gateway (west-1). Threshold crossed at 1799901228, current 5xx spike ~12% over baseline. Triage channel opened. Please respond if oncall.

sanjay: I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking ingress pools. Can someone confirm if there's a deploy in the last 30m?

marta: not from infra. last deploy was a small runtime patch 90m ago, not targeted to edge routing.

alex: I'm seeing repeated TIMEOUTs from upstream model replicas in west-1-rt1. Latency to model nodes jumped to 3s -> 12s around 1799901100.

lee: Confirmed. NLB backend 10.4.32.* showing connect timeouts and then 502 from proxy. Might be a network blip between edge gateway and serving fleet.

incident-bot: Impact estimate: ~18% of requests from west-us region failing with 5xx in last 5m. Top affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Top customers: internal-beta-1 and partner-acme (rate-limited but seeing errors). SLO at risk for west-us.

emily: I'll start failover to east-us (route-steer) for new traffic and enable aggressive retry policy for client-facing gateways. Doing canary for 10% -> 50% if steady.

raman: Before we steer, can we evict KV caches? If we shift traffic we might amplify origin load. Also check warmup of east pools.

alex: Good call. east-us has spare capacity but cold-start on some quantized shards. I'll spin up an extra 4 replicas in east-1 and pre-warm with synthetic prefixes.

sanjay: Debugging logs: showing repeated 504s from rpc-serv to model-host-rt1-03 with stack traces referencing libuv connect timeout. Attaching snippet: ```
[1799901210] rpc-serv: upstream_connect_timeout to model-host-rt1-03 (10.4.32.103) after 12000ms
[1799901211] proxy: returning 502 to client, upstream_failure_count=18
```

marta: Network team - any ongoing maintenance in west-1? @netops

support-bot: Noted ~ 2 customer-reported incidents opened: #INC-43812 (partner-acme) and #INC-43813 (internal-beta-1). Both report large errors on /chat.

lee: Netops says no planned maintenance. I'm seeing packet loss at west-1 egress path toward the serving cluster (sporadic 2-5% loss), could be a transient route flap with our cloud provider.

emily: Start steering 15% now -> 40% in 5m -> 80% if errors drop below 1%. I'll post updates. :white_check_mark:

raman: Preparing rollback plan in case east saturates. If p99 tokens latency > 2s in east after steering, we pause and re-evaluate. Also enabling prefix/KV-cache bypass where safe to avoid cold miss storm.

sanjay: Oncall mitigation commands executed: ```
# increase route-weight for east-us
redwood ctl route steer --from west-1 --to east-1 --weight 0.15
# enable aggressive client retry
redwood ctl gateway config set --retry-policy aggressive --region west-1
```

incident-bot: Automated monitors: failover initiated, alerting escalation to SRE. Live graphs: https://metrics.redwood/internal/d/edge/5xx?from=1799901000

alex: After steering 15%, west 5xx dropped to 6% in last 2m, east error rate stable at 0.8%. Prewarming helped.

marta: We should communicate to support and customers. Emily, can you draft a short status?

emily: Posting status to status.redwoodinference.com: "We are mitigating elevated error rates impacting west-us. Traffic is being routed to alternate region; impact reduced. Engineers are investigating the root cause. Next update in 15 minutes."

support-bot: Customer notes added to INC-43812 and INC-43813. ETA for next update 15m.

lee: Netops confirms provider-side route flap cleared at 1799901920. Loss returned <0.1%. We should gradually bring traffic back after 10m of stable metrics.

raman: Rolling plan: keep 40% in east for 10m -> if p95 latency <1.2s and 5xx <1% then shift back 25% every 5m. I'll run the automation job to adjust weights.

sanjay: Root-cause hypotheses: inter-AZ egress throttling or a noisy tenant causing head-of-line in proxy connections to model hosts. We'll correlate connection-level stats with tenant IDs.

alex: Also found a JMS backlog spike on rt1-cpu-2 around 1799901000 that coincides with first errors — investigating whether model batcher got overloaded due to short bursts.

marta: Good work. After we stabilize, we should open a postmortem and include mitigation timeline, customer impact, and suggested mitigations (circuit breaker tuning, KV cache warmup, cross-region prewarm). I'll own the postmortem.

emily: Current status: west 5xx = 2.1% (down from 18%), east 5xx = 0.6%. Traffic split west:50% east:50% for now. Next update in 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV3 -> monitoring. If errors rise above 5% again, paging will escalate to SEV2.

sanjay: Oncall handoff note for next shift: keep an eye on model-host-rt1-03 and NLB connect failures. Recorded commands used and links to graphs in channel.

raman: I'll keep the automation running for gradual rollback and log correlation scripts active. If anything spikes, call the SRE lead.

marta: Thanks team. Good fast mitigation. We'll follow up with a detailed timeline and postmortem once fully stable. :clap:
